text: qualia_sense length = min(n/16, 1.0) is a magic number I wrote in Phase 0 (qualia_sense.py:123). It caps the length feature at 16 characters, which is what makes the repetition signature freeze past N~13 (QD-7). Flagged there, not fixed: picking a different constant only moves the magic number, so the fix is either to derive the cap from the stimulus set or to drop the saturating form.

The 18 emotion values in bench_consciousness_universe.py:153+ are arithmetic over sha256(name) bits and never read the simulation output at all — the heatmap the owner originally pasted is a rendering of a hash. Flagged in QD-1 as out of scope. Fixing it needs a decision about what emotions should be grounded in, since there is no emotion ground truth in the repo.
